Card Q&A.a: This effect trashes an Option card that was placed by a "place this card in the battle area" effect.
Card Q&A.q: What does the "trash 1 Option card in your opponent's battle area" effect do, exactly?

Card Q&A.a: Yes, you can trash either player's Option card.
Card Q&A.q: If either me or my opponent has an Option card in the battle area, can I use this card's [When Digivolving] [When Attacking] effect to trash it?

Effect: {Hand} [Counter] ＜Blast Digivolve＞ (Your Digimon may digivolve into this card without paying the cost.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Until the end of your opponent's turn, this Digimon gains ＜Blocker＞ and isn't affected by their Digimon's effects.
[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] [Once Per Turn] By trashing 1 Option card in the battle area, this Digimon unsuspends.
Special Rule: ＜Overflow (-4)＞ (As this card moves from the field or under a card to an area other than those, lose 4 memory.)
